test_title: PYST 49 - SSC CHSL 2025 - Quantitative Aptitude (Held On: 30 Nov, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: maths
question: A sum becomes Rs. 11,760 in 6 years at r % simple interest. If the interest rate had been (r + 5)% p.a., the amount would have been Rs. 13,320. Find the principal.
solution:
**Given:**

A₁ = 11760

A₂ = 13320

t = 6

Rate difference = 5%

**Formula Used:**

Simple Interest = (P × R × t) ÷ 100

Difference in Amount = (P × Rate difference × t) ÷ 100

**Calculation:**

⇒ Difference in amount = 13320 − 11760 = 1560

⇒ 1560 = (P × 5 × 6) ÷ 100

⇒ 1560 = (30P) ÷ 100

⇒ 1560 = (3P) ÷ 10

⇒ P = (1560 × 10) ÷ 3

⇒ P = 15600 ÷ 3 = 5200

**∴ The correct answer is 5200.**
